fields.Name: IT186 - List Member Mutations (client transport)
fields.Description: The bulk member mutations of the Lists API, called over GraphQL against a running MJAPI, deterministic (no model calls). LC1 adds records to a throwaway list (a repeated ID is added once), moves two of them to a second list with removeFromSource, and removes one from the second list; after each step it checks the mutation counts and the member counts in the database. The check creates and deletes its own two MJ: Lists rows. It reports Skipped when the run is not on the client transport.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: AddRecordsToList, CopyRecordsToList with removeFromSource and RemoveRecordsFromList change the members of the right lists and report the right counts over the wire.
